source.description: One already filtered/downsampled audiovisual sample recording, its supplied event file, and the original version marker. No MRI or other source members are staged.

license.use_boundary: Official documentation supplies these data for familiarization with MNE and excludes MEG/MRI hardware-performance evaluation. No unrestricted redistribution grant was established. Local method-control use only; do not publish source-containing images without resolving permission.

attribution: MNE sample dataset, acquired with a Neuromag Vectorview system at the MGH/HMS/MIT Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging; MNE project source distribution.

checksum_provenance.archive_md5: Independently published in the pinned MNE 1.12.1 dataset registry and OSF file metadata.
checksum_provenance.archive_sha256: Independently published by OSF file metadata; metadata current_version=6 and version-6 size confirmed before acquisition.
checksum_provenance.member_hashes: Locally measured from the read-only selected cache files. Staging must independently establish these exact bytes as members of the complete published-dual-hash archive; cached identity alone is insufficient.
checksum_provenance.head_size: HEAD reports version-1 size despite version-6 hashes. This metadata discrepancy never relaxes measured archive size or either checksum.

header_observations.evidence: Cache header-only MNE1.12.1 read; selected member identity must still pass original archive authentication.
header_observations.projector_scope: Three inactive PCA vectors cover magnetometers only; one inactive average-reference vector covers EEG only. No supplied vector has gradiometer columns.
